data.name: Utaburg
data.detailed_description:
Utaburg is an open-world MMORPG divided into maps that connect together to form one large world. The world of Utaburg is alive with its own life. NPCs have their own duties, are happy to tell stories, and factions are constantly waging wars over territories against each other. Two days a week they participate in a castle war, and from time to time they even organize raids on bosses themselves - all of this happens in the world of Utaburg, even if there are no players nearby. The world is alive all the time.

As a creator, I put a very strong emphasis on immersion. I want you, as a player, to feel that the world is alive - because it really is. Something is constantly happening, and you are joining a world that does not force you down a specific path. You can farm, grind, craft, gather, trade on the player market, influence the economy, join one of the factions if you want to (but you don't have to), create guilds with other players, fight in arenas, or hunt other players in open PVP.

I have been a fan of the MMORPG genre for many years, and in Utaburg I have gathered everything that I liked the most from many classic titles.

A few specifics:

Combat:

  • tab target with dynamic abilities, skillshots that can miss

  • a variety of classes that complement each other in combat

  • challenging bosses that in most cases require several players to defeat

Class System:

  • you start as a Novice and at level 10 you choose your first class, which can be Warrior, Scout, Rogue or Merchant

  • when you reach level 40 you can choose a second class:
    -- Warrior -> Knight or Guardian
    -- Scout -> Hunter or Wayfarer
    -- Rogue -> Assassin or Marauder
    -- Merchant -> Blacksmith or Alchemist

  • each class has its own unique mechanics and perks

Skill and Equipment System:

  • all equipment items have skills, and these are the skills you use on the battlefield

  • items have tiers from T1 to T6

  • every item in the game must first be crafted by a player before it enters the game, and every item is marked with the nickname of the player who created it

  • items can be enchanted (upgraded, the classic +N system), and in case of failure the item is permanently destroyed

Character Builds:

  • there are STR, AGI, DEX, VIT, INTE, LUK stats that define your character's strength and specific build

  • there is a Mastery Tree that unlocks special passives that shape your class

  • the Mastery Tree can be freely reset and you can save your builds for quick access (max 3)

Card System:

  • every monster in the game can drop its own card, which has unique passives and even abilities

  • every item in the game has slots where cards can be inserted

Mount System:

  • the game has a classic mount system where mounts can be obtained, and mounts increase your movement speed outside of combat

The game is currently in Alpha, and we are working towards moving into Beta. Anyone can join the game together with the community right now, simply by joining our Discord.

The world of Utaburg is wide open!

data.short_description: Utaburg is an open-world MMORPG. Join a world that puts a strong emphasis on immersion. Combat is dynamic. Choose one of four unique classes, then at level 40 choose a second class that complements your first. Fight, explore, create guilds, shape the economy - you decide.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (version 21H1 / build 19043) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD FX-6300 (4 cores, 3.0 GHz, SSE2)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU DirectX 11 z 2 GB VRAM (NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X / Intel UHD Graphics 630)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: This game is online-only and requires a constant internet connection. There is no offline mode. A keyboard and mouse are required. Minimum supported resolution: 1280×720. Target performance: 1280×720 at 30–60 FPS.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit (lub Windows 10 64-bit 21H1+)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 (6 cores, 3.6 GHz)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT (6 GB VRAM) or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: This game is online-only and requires a constant internet connection. There is no offline mode. An SSD is recommended to reduce zone loading times. Target performance: 1920×1080 at 60–120 FPS.
